title: Tree control drag and drop does not work with emulate touch from mouse enabled
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0]
- Not reproducible in v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.26100 - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA RTX A2000 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6103) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11850H @ 2.50GHz (16 Threads)

### Issue description

When project setting `input_devices/pointing/emulate_touch_from_mouse` is enabled, tree controls with at least one item in them do not generate calls to `_get_drag_data` when dragging.

If the tree control is empty, the drag is initiated as expected.

### Steps to reproduce

Either use the project provided below, or create a new project, add a 2d scene with a Tree control and the following script:
```
extends Tree

func _ready():
	var item: TreeItem = create_item()
	item.set_text(0, "Dragging this only works if emulate touch from mouse is disable.")

func _get_drag_data(at_position: Vector2) -> Variant:
	var item: TreeItem = get_selected()
	print("Get Drag Data ", item)
```
Running this and trying to drag the item prints `Get Drag Data <...>` to the console, as expected.

Enable `Emulate Touch From Mouse` in Project Settings.

Run again, and dragging can no longer be initiated.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[treedragtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18623419/treedragtest.zip)
